author: Paige_F

title: Fun morning exploring Barcelona!
text: Easy to follow/understand.  Pointed out many things I missed in a previous trip to Barcelona.  Highly recommend Antonio.  Also, gave me several recommendations to further explore on my own.
author: Ronald_A

title: Great way to explore the city with limited time.
text: We did the 3 hour personal tour. Phillip was friendly and knowledgeable about the city and the tour was personalized with what we wanted to see and some great recommendations.
author: Mack_S

title: See more of Barcelona on a segway.
text: This is a great way to see Barcelona!!  Philip our guide was really good.  The segways were so much fun and safe.  It really is easy to learn. What a great way to see most of Barcelona.  We were able to see more things in a shorter amount of time because we were able to cover a lot more area on a segway.
author: Mary_P

title: Very Fun!
text: Segways are always fun and this tour was a great way of getting to know the city. Val was very fun as well. Recommended!
author: Yarissa_M

title: Profession meets fun - highly recommended
text: We enjoyed a very personal trip - 4 people, our native German speaking guide Zoe and her colleague Dominik. Went to many interesting places and Zoe made everyone feeling comfortable, guiding us thru the traffic to a lot of interesting places.
author: Chris_Nautique

title: AMAZING! This was the first time we had...
text:
AMAZING! This was the first time we had used Segways and we all loved it! We had a lesson at the beginning which proved just how easy they were to use. So good to get around in the heat and travel a bit of distance even managing a bit of pace so we had a bit of a breeze. Our tour started with one guide and then part way through he swapped out with another guide. They were both very informative and we learnt a lot. It didn't effect our tour in anyway.
we loved it so much that we booked a similar tour in Malta for a few days later!
author: Marie

title: We had a great guide named Diego. We...
text: We had a great guide named Diego. We saw Roman ruins that we didn't know existed. Off the beaten track. It was enlightening and wonderful. The only drawback was that viator gave us the wrong address number. It is NOT 2 it is 26. Thank goodness we got there early to look for it. It was two blocks away and we kept walking in circles. PLEASE VIATOR GET THE ADDRESS RIGHT
